EU Aviation Agency Advises Avoiding Airspace Over Iran, Iraq

The European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) has issued a directive for operators to avoid airspaces over Iran and Iraq, along with Lebanon, until August 31. The agency also recommended exercising caution in the airspace of several other Middle Eastern countries. This advisory comes amid heightened regional tensions.
